question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Misanthropic
solution:
The correct answer is '**Antisocial**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym of "**misanthropic**" among the given options is '**Antisocial**'.
 
• "**Misanthropic**" describes a person who dislikes humankind and avoids human society.
 
• Among the options provided, "**antisocial** [असामाजिक (Asamajik)]" closely aligns with this meaning, denoting a reluctance or unwillingness to engage or associate with others in a friendly or normal manner. Both terms imply a certain level of aversion or lack of interest in social interactions or human society.
 
 
• *Example: His reclusive behavior and disdain for social gatherings led others to label him as somewhat **antisocial**.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Antisocial.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Humanitarian** - Concerned with promoting human welfare and happiness; in Hindi: मानवीय (Manaviya)
 
• **Sociable** - Fond of company; friendly and enjoys being with others; in Hindi: मिलनसार (Milansar)
 
• **Philanthropic** - Showing a desire to help others, especially by giving money to good causes; in Hindi: परोपकारी (Paropkari)
